images.name: 12_escape_A_the_big_slide
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Photoreal cinematic horror game concept art, landscape 16:9. References are material and atmosphere references, not exact layout: override their old geometry with this description. One gigantic abandoned soft-play frame fills a round warehouse 155m across, steel truss roof 42m high, wall to wall with NO peripheral bare floor or other attractions. Central circular court 22m diameter has worn blue-green checker foam puzzle mats and painted yellow ring. Six concentric soft-play frame rings rise AWAY from court like stadium terraces: 2,4,6,8,10,12 storeys, each storey 2.8m; tops are 11m-deep netted terraces with padded rails, foam stadium stair aisles. Under terraces dense decks, net corridors, crawl tubes. Worn coloured vinyl padded posts, black knotted safety nets, coloured mat decks, red square bubble-window panels, glossy single-solid-colour plastic tubes. Wide lens, dusty, quiet, abandoned, light haze, convincing scale. FINALE LIGHTING: every working fluorescent strip glows DEEP RED, haze red, structure red and black shadows; no white ambient fixtures; the escape is the ONE green-lit location. Some fixtures dead. No people, children, animals or entity. No reception, snack bar, tables, party rooms, inflatables, arcade, ball pit, neon decoration, watermark, UI or HUD. No striped slides. Camera on court floor looking steeply UP the immense stepped bowl, tiny short red padded post on court. Escape at the VERY TOP: on highest terrace TWELVE storeys up against wall, ONE green lamp directly above the clearly open round entrance mouth of a gigantic solid RED tube slide. Show the entrance on top terrace; tube corkscrews a few turns down outside of top ring and then exits horizontally straight THROUGH hall wall into darkness, never down to court. A continuous foam stair aisle visibly climbs all terraces towards that green lamp. Every other thing red/shadow. No text.
images.weakness: Terraces read too vertically and twelve storeys are unclear; the slide lacks the requested corkscrew. Original retained because retry added unwanted sign lettering.
